# PR checklist

- [ ] Is the title correct? `<type>(<scope>): <what the change does>`, where the type is one of feat, fix, docs, test, ci, build, perf, refactor, style, chore, revert, release, and the scope is the path the change touches. For example `fix(tac_plus-ng/main.c): close the listener after a bind error`.
- [ ] Does `tac_plus-ng/tests/run-tests` pass locally?
- [ ] Is there a test for the change (where appropriate)?
- [ ] Are the manual (`tac_plus-ng/doc/manual.xml`) and the sample configurations updated (where appropriate)?
